text_simplified: The text discusses the rights of children over their parents and highlights the importance of the tarbiyah (upbringing) of children upon religious and moral values. It also mentions that Allah does not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves. Parents must reinforce positive behavior in their children through guidance and good example.
